# `company.budget_amounts`

Budget cells: one nonzero amount per budget, account, customer or class, and month.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this budget cell. |
| `budget_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with budget_id + account_id + dimension_key + month | — | budgets.id | Budget this amount belongs to. |
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with budget_id + account_id + dimension_key + month | ix_budget_amounts_account | accounts.id | Account budgeted. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | customers.id | Customer or job this amount is for, on a customer budget; null otherwise. |
| `class_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | classes.id | Class this amount is for, on a class budget; null otherwise. |
| `dimension_key` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with budget_id + account_id + dimension_key + month | — | — | The customer or class id, or empty on a company budget; part of the cell identity. |
| `month` | VARCHAR(7) | no | — | unique with budget_id + account_id + dimension_key + month | — | — | Month budgeted, YYYY-MM, within the budget fiscal year. |
| `amount_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Budgeted amount in home-currency minor units: the month net for profit and loss, the ending balance for balance sheet; statement sign, so income and expense are both positive. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp this amount was last set. |
| `updated_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal who last set this amount. |
| `updated_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface this amount was last set through. |
